canonical_name: Edzell grid connection (potential data centre site)
summary: An 800MW gate 2 grid connection reported by APRS (citing NESO's Existing Agreements Register) for 'Edzel', stated by APRS to be intended for connection to the new Brechin substation in Angus — the largest of five grid-connection-only sites APRS has 'not otherwise seen elsewhere'. Edzell is a village five miles north of Brechin, adjacent to the former RAF Edzell base. No planning application, developer announcement or press coverage has been found; no developer has been identified.
maturity_explanation: Only evidence is a reported 800MW gate 2 grid connection (to the new Brechin substation) in NESO's Existing Agreements Register as relayed by APRS (page updated July 2026). PlanIt searches of Angus 2019-2026 for 'data centre' and 'Edzell' found no relevant planning record; no developer or press attribution found.

latest_development.headline: APRS data centre map (updated 29 July 2026) lists Edzell 800MW (to connect to the new Brechin substation) among five gate 2 connection sites 'not otherwise seen elsewhere'

unknowns: The NESO register row (connectee, connection site, agreement/connection dates) has not been independently extracted; the 800MW figure and Brechin substation detail rest on APRS's reading.

Exact location: whether the site is at/near Edzell village, the former RAF Edzell base, Edzell Muir, or simply named 'Edzell' for the connection locality near the new Brechin 400kV substation is unknown.
No developer or connectee identified by any source; speculation about the former RAF Edzell base is unsupported by any located evidence.
Whether the end use is a data centre rather than another large demand user, hydrogen or storage project connecting at Brechin.
No planning activity of any kind was found in Angus.
Timeline of the new Brechin substation (part of SSEN transmission upgrades) and the implied connection date.
